author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear decides what is the greatest Porsche 911 ever! From the 1973 Carrera RS 2.7 to the latest S/T, via a choice of any 911 from Porsche’s secret collection, the very best are driven to decide which stands head and shoulders above the rest as the ultimate rear-engined icon.
